definitions.explanation: To get away from a dangerous or unpleasant situation by leaving quickly.
To avoid confrontation or responsibility by leaving.

examples.notes: から marks what you're escaping from

examples.japanese: {責任|せきにん}から{逃|に}げてはいけない。
examples.english: You shouldn't run away from responsibility.

examples.japanese: {危|あぶ}ないから{早|はや}く{逃|に}げて！
examples.english: It's dangerous, so run away quickly!

examples.japanese: {鳥|とり}がかごから{逃|に}げてしまったので、{一日中|いちにちじゅう}{探|さが}していた。
examples.english: The bird escaped from its cage, so I spent all day looking for it.

examples.japanese: {問題|もんだい}から{逃|に}げないで。
examples.english: Don't run away from the problem.

examples.japanese: {現実|げんじつ}から{逃|に}げても{解決|かいけつ}しない。
examples.english: Running away from reality won't solve anything.

examples.japanese: {仕事|しごと}から{逃|に}げたくなる{時|とき}がある。
examples.english: Sometimes I feel like running away from work.

examples.japanese: {面倒|めんどう}なことから{逃|に}げるな。
examples.english: Don't run away from difficult things.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). Pair: {逃|に}がす (transitive, to let escape). Pattern: Xから{逃|に}げる (escape from X).

ASPECT: ている indicates completed action or ongoing state. {逃|に}げている = 'has escaped' or 'is on the run.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{危険|きけん}から{逃|に}げる (escape from danger)
・{警察|けいさつ}から{逃|に}げる (run from police)
・{責任|せきにん}から{逃|に}げる (run from responsibility)
・{逃|に}げ{出|だ}す (run away, make a break for it)
・{逃|に}げ{回|まわ}る (run around trying to escape)

CONTRAST:
・{逃|に}げる (intransitive): escape, run away
・{逃|に}がす (transitive): let escape, miss (an opportunity)

RELATED:
・{逃|に}げ{道|みち} (escape route)
・{逃|とう}亡 (flight, escape—noun, formal)
